review_description: We had Steadfast upgrade our existing solar system. That happened quickly.  However 3 days after installation the system fell over and was not working ss it should.  Contacted Ryan at Steadfast who asked for photo's of issue which were supplied. He stated that there was indeed sn issue and that he would get back to us when he had an update.  3 weeks later no update. System still producing less power than the original system.  Eventually found the issue mysell. being a loose connection on the inverter.  System now working well. Sent Ryan an email stating my disappointment with the after sales service.  Still no reply from Steadfast some 5-6 weeks later.

Thank you for your exceptional customer service over the past few weeks. Your knowledge of the products and services, combined with your focus on keeping the customer at the heart of what you do, has been impressive. You've tailored everything to meet our specific needs rather than offering a one-size-fits-all solution. Your attentiveness and understanding have made this experience a pleasure. Thank you!

The Sales/Quoting process was very smooth. Peter spent as much time as was needed to work through the options and prices. The professional advice given, prior to sale, was greatly appreciated. Arriving with a box of doughnuts didn't hurt either.The installation was smooth and very professional. During the initial installation visit - a major issue was discovered in our distribution board. Work continued as far as possible - giving us time to have our electrician work on replacing and upgrading our distribution board. Once that was resolved, the installers returned to complete the job. The whole process was very smooth - including the handover and setting up of the monitoring software on our iPads.Customer service was stellar. Any time we called with questions or issues - Steadfast Solar was responsive and helpful. The whole process was a give and take - there were some supplier delays which we accepted and there were delays caused by our distribution board issue. The whole process worked smoothly - with both parties making every effort to work with the other smoothly.The whole process was hassle free and the system is great. Very happy.

Peter took the additional time and effort to explain the system to my needs after doing my own research across panel brands, inverters and racking. I used a lot of the information from SolarQuotes in consultation with Peter to make the final decision based on needs, cost, brands, warranty and other reviews. I’m now producing a significant amount of electricity to power the major appliances during the day.

Peter has the best customer service i have ever come across. From the first call to the after service i can not fault anything.Peter drove an hour to my house to meet with me to explain how it all works, he even brought pastries with him!We got several quotes from different companies, Peter was the only one who went out of his way to accomodate my very busy schedule.Once we decided to go with Steadfast Peter again drove to us to sign paperwork.The panels were put in less than 2 weeks later, the guys were great!Peter also drove back to me to say thank you with a box of choccies!He came recommended from a work colleague, and i will be recommending him to all my family, friends and clients (I work for a building company)
